title: MeshMetrics: A Precise Implementation of Distance-Based Image Segmentation Metrics
mechanism: Mesh-based computation of distance metrics; open-source tools differ by up to 30 pct-points NSD on identical masks (with arxiv:2410.02630).
adaptation: Fix one reference implementation for relF1@2 / NSD; cross-check our in-house relF1 against surface-distance and MeshMetrics.
min_experiment: Arm: three implementations on val-54. Kill: differences < 0.005.
evidence: R: 11 open-source tools compared; HD deviations > 100 mm, NSD > 30 pct-points.
